The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''32,920 before the Battle of Yavin''', also known as '''3,533 after the Tho Yor Arrival''', was a year in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic history]]. [[Je'daii Master|Master]] [[Deela jan Morolla]] of the [[Je'daii Order]] was alive at that [[Time/Legends|time]], and the tradition of the [[Great Journey]] had been established by that point.<ref name="DOTJ">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>
